items.title: The trust balance: deposits before the ask
items.description: Using the same illustrative point system as L3 (each genuine deposit is worth 5, the big ask costs 15), drag the number of deposits made before the ask to see whether the balance stays positive afterward. At 4 deposits, this reproduces Alex's actual balance of 5; at 0, it reproduces Jordan's -15.
